- **Incident Overview**: A two-vehicle collision occurred at the intersection of Main Street and Oak Avenue at approximately 3:15 PM on [date], involving a 2018 Honda Civic (Driver A) and a 2020 Ford F-150 (Driver B). Witnesses report Driver A failed to stop at a red light, striking Driver B’s truck as it entered the intersection.

- **Damages & Injuries**: The Honda Civic sustained severe front-end damage, while the Ford F-150 had moderate damage to its passenger side. Driver A suffered minor whiplash and was treated at the scene; Driver B reported no injuries. Both vehicles were towed due to inoperability.

- **Police Findings**: Officer [Name] cited Driver A for running a red light (VC 21453(a)) and issued a traffic collision report (#[number]). No DUI or mechanical failures were suspected; the accident was attributed to driver error.
